coaching.title: Easy 6mi + Strides
coaching.message: 10 days out, taper week 1 (~55% of peak volume). Easy Zone 2, 6 miles, HR 138-150 bpm — nothing above conversational. Finish with 4 relaxed strides at race pace, ~20 sec each, full recovery between. Keep it smooth; no run over 90 minutes for the rest of the taper. Today's about staying loose while you travel from Cieneguilla into Lima, not building fitness.

coaching.title: Fuel Right
coaching.message: Short easy run means no in-run fueling needed — water only. Target ~220g carbs today to keep glycogen topped off through the taper, with solid protein at breakfast and post-run to support recovery. Travel day in Lima: don't let packing and checkout crowd out real meals.

coaching.title: Recovery
coaching.message: Light mobility work after the run, then let gym time this evening stay easy — mobility and single-leg/hip/core activation, not a hard session. Freshness beats fitness from here. Prioritize sleep despite the travel logistics (check-in, gym, packing).

coaching.title: Mental Edge
coaching.message: 10 days to Kranjska Gora. The work is banked — this week is about trusting it, not chasing more. Use today's strides to rehearse race-pace rhythm and visualize the alpine climbs. Let the travel chaos roll off; the taper is doing its job even when it feels like you're doing less.
